text: Artificial Intelligence is developing quickly. Today we have "narrow AI", which is good at one task, like translation. But many experts are working on "general AI", also called AGI, which could think like a human across many areas. AGI might bring huge benefits, such as solving medical problems and making our lives easier. However, there are also serious risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Some scientists predict AGI could arrive in 20 to 30 years, while others think it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure, so we should discuss both the hopes and the dangers.
